svg.font-family: Segoe UI, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component Model
svg.desc: Callers (the web UI through the Next.js proxy, the Windows console, MCP over HTTP, scripts and Open WebUI, and MCP over stdio) reach the FastAPI routes or the stdio MCP process; both call the same shared services (resolver, router, LLM adapter, versions, evals, compare, memory, the agent loop and pipelines), which use one store, the AI providers and the agent tools.
svg.text: Every door leads to the same services, one store and the AI you choose
no key check: its own process
backend/app on :8000 • main.py, auth.py: every route but / and /health needs a key
routes are thin: they validate, then call the shared services below
the same Python functions for REST, /mcp and stdio MCP
stdio MCP imports the same services
